snippet.title: cavesleeper.mp4
snippet.description:
cavesleeper is a short survival horror game where you are stuck on a lift, trying to reach the surface, while dealing with the monsters that are roaming inside.

This entire game has been put together by a single person (Me :D) over the course of around 9 Days for the Falling Block Jam 2025, and I REALLY tried my best to make it as good as I possibly can, but don't expect a huge game out of this.

Game: https://obradev.itch.io/cavesleeper

Everything in the game is also copyright free and can be used for any type of content.
